messages:
Maria: Heads-up — onboarding tenant `redwood-ai-poc` needs ND/NC GPU quota and a few network limit tweaks in West Europe. Opening tracking here.
Sam: What SKUs are we asking for? NDv4 or ND40rs?
Maria: Primary preference: `Standard_ND96asr_A100_v4` for batch experiments, fallback `Standard_ND40rs_v2` for latency testing. Also need 10x `NC6s_v3` for smaller jobs.
Jonah: Any region constraints? We usually prefer northeurope but capacity is tight.
Maria: They want West Europe due to data residency. We checked availability and there are quotas but no reservation. Requires quota + capacity reservation request.
Ashley: Can we file a reservation or do we open a support ticket for quota increase first? Reservations sometimes need subscription-level approval.
Sam: Start with quota increase (fast) and parallel capacity reservation request (long lead). I'll open Support ticket and Reservation request.
Maria: Created initial support ticket: #AZ-21004567 — quota increase for GPUs + VM cores. Leaving summary here and attaching the subscription id.
Jonah: Share the ticket link?
Maria: quota-bot: New support ticket created -> https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/HelpAndSupportBlade/id/21004567
Sam: Adding requested numbers: 
- ND96asr: 8 -> 20
- ND40rs_v2: 0 -> 8
- NC6s_v3: 5 -> 15
Also NSG ephemeral port limit: increase `allowedTnat`? (we hit 5000 ephemeral port rule in staging)
Kevin: For NSG, Azure has default SNAT port limits per VM/instance. We should ask networking to increase SNAT for the subnet or suggest a NAT gateway.
Ashley: Can we get away with NAT gateway + LB SKU change instead of port limit bump? That's usually faster and cheaper than quota escalation.
Maria: Good point. Tenant prefers minimal infra changes; but NAT gateway is acceptable. Add NAT gateway request to the ticket.
Sam: Filed Reservation request separately: Reservation ID RSRV-77821 (Standard_ND96asr_A100_v4, West Europe) — Azure says provisional hold pending quota approval.
infra-bot: Reservation RSRV-77821 status: Pending (Azure assigned hold).
Jonah: Any ETA from Azure support?
Maria: Support replied: initial review 24–48h, provisioning 3–10 business days after approval. They asked for workload description & expected sustained vCPU/GPU hours.
Sam: I added expected runbook: 24/7 8 GPUs for 6 months for model training + burst to 20 for nightly pipelines. Also included cost center tag & support contact.
Kevin: Cost note — ND96a reservations will add ~€3.8k/day if fully hot; recommend reserved capacity commit for 6–12 months to save ~20%. I'll put numbers in the ticket.
Maria: Adding NSG / NAT change suggestion and cost breakdown.
Sam: Quota-bot: Support ticket AZ-21004567 updated by Sam at 2026-06-10 09:12 UTC — Added NAT gateway request and capacity justification.
Ashley: Small ask — can we mirror reservation in a secondary region (France Central) as fallback? Azure warned West Europe best effort only.
Maria: Added fallback plan: FR Central ND40rs_v2 x8 as failover. Will only spin if West Europe cannot fulfill.
Jonah: Any blockers from security/compliance? Public NAT gateway allowed?
Kevin: Need egress IP control. Use Firewall + NAT IPs, document in SOC. I'll prep notes for security review.
Maria: OK, next steps: Sam to follow up with support in 48h, Kevin to prepare cost + SOC notes, Jonah to validate subnet NAT changes with networking, Ashley to confirm fallback region acceptance with the customer. We'll reconvene in this thread. :thumbsup:
Sam: Will do. Ping me if we need to escalate to Azure account team.
Maria: Thanks — I'll paste final ticket link and reservation ID here when provisioned.
quota-bot: Reminder: if quota request not approved within 72h, escalate to Azure CSM.
Kevin: I'll loop in our Azure CSM if we don't get approval by 2026-06-13 EOD.
Maria: Thanks everyone. Keeping this thread as single source of truth for onboarding.
Sam: FYI — quick Azure CLI to check current GPU usage in region:
```
az vm list-usage --location "westeurope" --query "[?name.value=='GPUs'].{name:name.value,current:currentValue,limit:limit}" -o table
```
Maria: Closing note: ticket AZ-21004567 currently awaiting quotas team. I'll update thread with final status."
